arabic text: KIS TERHA APNI TABAHI KI KHABAR LEJAYE
english translation text: HOW WILL SHE (BIBI ZAINAB A.S.) TAKE BACK THE NEWS OF HER TRAGEDY?

arabic text: KIS TERHA APNI TABAHI KI KHABAR LEJAYE\nPAAS ZAINAB KE BACHA KYA HAI JO GHAR LEJAAYE
english translation text: HOW WILL SHE (BIBI ZAINAB A.S.) TAKE BACK THE NEWS OF HER TRAGEDY?\nWHAT HAS ZAINAB GOT LEFT TO TAKE BACK HOME?

arabic text: PAON ZAKHMI HAI(N) TO RAHO(N) MAIN HAI(N) PATHAR KAANTAY\nJAANE AABID KO KAHA(N) TAK YEH SAFAR LE JAAYE\nPAAS ZAINAB KE BACHA KYA HAI JO GHAR LEJAAYE
english translation text: HIS (IMAM SAJJAD) FEET ARE INJURED AND THE PATH IS FILLED WITH STONES AND THORNS\nWONDER HOW FAR THIS JOURNEY WILL TAKE HIM\nWHAT HAS ZAINAB GOT LEFT TO TAKE BACK HOME?

arabic text: BOLI HONGI ALI AKBAR KO SAJA KER ZAINAB\nCHAAND KO MERE KISSI KI NA NAZAR LE JAAYE\nPAAS ZAINAB KE BACHA KYA HAI JO GHAR LEJAAYE
english translation text: WHEN SHE GOT ALI AKBAR READY, ZAINAB MUST HAVE SAID\nMAY NO EVIL EYE TAKE AWAY MY CHILD\nWHAT HAS ZAINAB GOT LEFT TO TAKE BACK HOME?

arabic text: SOCHTI HOGI YEH BANO MERA BACH JAAYE SUHAAG\nHURMULA MUJH SAI MERE LAKHT-E-JIGER LEJAAYE\nPAAS ZAINAB KE BACHA KYA HAI JO GHAR LEJAAYE
english translation text: BANO MUST BE THINKING THAT MAY MY HOUSEHOLD BE SAVED\nHURMALA IS TAKING AWAY MY BELOVED ONE\nWHAT HAS ZAINAB GOT LEFT TO TAKE BACK HOME?

arabic text: RAKH KE ANKHON KE SULAGTAY HUWE IS MAQTAL MEI\nLAASH BACHO(N) KI KE SHABBIR KA SAR LEJAAYE\nPAAS ZAINAB KE BACHA KYA HAI JO GHAR LEJAAYE
english translation text: EYES ARE SMOULDERING IN THIS DESERT\nTHEY ARE TAKING THE BODIES OF CHILDREN AND SHABBIR'S HEAD?\nWHAT HAS ZAINAB GOT LEFT TO TAKE BACK HOME?

arabic text: LAI GAYEE BAAP KA SAYA TO SARO(N) SE UNKE\nAB YATEEMON KO HAWA CHAAHE JIDHAR LE JAAYE\nPAAS ZAINAB KE BACHA KYA HAI JO GHAR LEJAAYE
english translation text: GONE IS THE FATHER'S PRESENCE FROM THE LIFE OF THE CHILDREN\nNOW THE ORPHANS ARE VULNERABLE TO THE FORCES OF THE WORLD\nWHAT HAS ZAINAB GOT LEFT TO TAKE BACK HOME?
